videos.script: A message arrives on Tarefa's forum. Before anybody reads it, the platform asks a moderation endpoint about it. {{title}} The answer is a score for each category. Harassment, threats, spam. {{scores}} A score is not a decision. Somebody has to choose the line above which a message is blocked. {{threshold}} The lab's endpoint is a stand-in, a word list the course wrote. Its mistakes are the ones real classifiers make more quietly. {{standin}} It flags somebody reporting that they were called an idiot. It misses an insult spelt with a digit, and every insult written in Portuguese. {{errors}} So you will measure it against messages a person labelled. Precision, recall, and how the two move when the line moves. {{sweep}} Then you will draw two lines instead of one. Block what is nearly certain, send the middle to a person, and publish the rest. {{lanes}}
